Hmm, actually `parseVariableLengthInteger` uses parseByteField(1) internally which DOES write to outputStream ✓ (parseByteField → parseByteArrayField → outputStream.write). So getAlreadyParsed includes the varints ✓ and quicBuffer duplicates them (for the QUIC header reconstruction).

So I could compute the consumed length = getAlreadyParsed().length.
